select "users"."id", "users"."name" from "users" where "organisation_id" = ? and "is_active" = ? and exists (select * from "roles" inner join "model_has_roles" on "roles"."id" = "model_has_roles"."role_id" where "users"."id" = "model_has_roles"."model_id" and "model_has_roles"."model_type" = ? and "roles"."id" in (?)) and exists (select * from "staff_profiles" where "users"."id" = "staff_profiles"."user_id" and exists (select * from "staff_branch_assignments" where "staff_profiles"."id" = "staff_branch_assignments"."staff_profile_id" and "branch_id" = ? and "valid_from"::date <= ? and ("valid_until" is null or "valid_until"::date >= ?))) order by "name" asc

select count(*) as "aggregate" from "queue_entries" where "queue_entries"."organisation_id" = ? and "queue_entries"."branch_id" = ? and "queue_entries"."status" = ? and "queue_entries"."operational_date"::date <= ? and exists (select * from "visits" where "queue_entries"."visit_id" = "visits"."id" and "organisation_id" = ? and "branch_id" = ? and "status" = ? and "visit_type" = ?) and (SELECT t.chosen_zone FROM visit_triage_assessments t WHERE t.visit_id=queue_entries.visit_id ORDER BY t.sequence DESC LIMIT 1)='red' and exists (select * from "visits" where "queue_entries"."visit_id" = "visits"."id" and "assigned_doctor_user_id" = ?)

select COUNT(CASE WHEN queue_entries.status = 'waiting' AND queue_entries.operational_date = ? THEN 1 END) AS today,
             COUNT(CASE WHEN queue_entries.status = 'waiting' AND queue_entries.operational_date < ? THEN 1 END) AS carry_over,
             COUNT(CASE WHEN queue_entries.status = 'serving' THEN 1 END) AS serving,
             COUNT(CASE WHEN queue_entries.status = 'removed' THEN 1 END) AS removed from "queue_entries" inner join "visits" on "visits"."id" = "queue_entries"."visit_id" where "queue_entries"."organisation_id" = ? and "queue_entries"."branch_id" = ? and "visits"."assigned_doctor_user_id" = ? and "visits"."id" not in (select "queue_entries"."visit_id" from "queue_entries" where "queue_entries"."organisation_id" = ? and "queue_entries"."branch_id" = ? and "queue_entries"."status" = ? and "queue_entries"."operational_date"::date <= ? and exists (select * from "visits" where "queue_entries"."visit_id" = "visits"."id" and "organisation_id" = ? and "branch_id" = ? and "status" = ? and "visit_type" = ?) and (SELECT t.chosen_zone FROM visit_triage_assessments t WHERE t.visit_id=queue_entries.visit_id ORDER BY t.sequence DESC LIMIT 1)='red' and exists (select * from "visits" where "queue_entries"."visit_id" = "visits"."id" and "assigned_doctor_user_id" = ?)) limit 1

select "queue_entries"."id", "queue_entries"."organisation_id", "queue_entries"."branch_id", "queue_entries"."visit_id", "queue_entries"."operational_date", "queue_entries"."queue_number", "queue_entries"."status", "queue_entries"."queued_at", "queue_entries"."called_at", "queue_entries"."removed_at", "queue_entries"."removal_reason", "queue_entries"."returned_from_dispensary_at", "queue_entries"."lock_version" from "queue_entries" inner join "visits" on "visits"."id" = "queue_entries"."visit_id" where "queue_entries"."organisation_id" = ? and "queue_entries"."branch_id" = ? and "visits"."assigned_doctor_user_id" = ? and "visits"."id" not in (select "queue_entries"."visit_id" from "queue_entries" where "queue_entries"."organisation_id" = ? and "queue_entries"."branch_id" = ? and "queue_entries"."status" = ? and "queue_entries"."operational_date"::date <= ? and exists (select * from "visits" where "queue_entries"."visit_id" = "visits"."id" and "organisation_id" = ? and "branch_id" = ? and "status" = ? and "visit_type" = ?) and (SELECT t.chosen_zone FROM visit_triage_assessments t WHERE t.visit_id=queue_entries.visit_id ORDER BY t.sequence DESC LIMIT 1)='red' and exists (select * from "visits" where "queue_entries"."visit_id" = "visits"."id" and "assigned_doctor_user_id" = ?)) and "queue_entries"."status" = ? order by "queue_entries"."removed_at" desc limit 25

select "queue_entries".* from "queue_entries" inner join "visits" on "visits"."id" = "queue_entries"."visit_id" where "queue_entries"."organisation_id" = ? and "queue_entries"."branch_id" = ? and "queue_entries"."status" = ? and "queue_entries"."operational_date"::date <= ? and "visits"."status" = ? and "visits"."assigned_doctor_user_id" = ? and not exists (select 1 from "queue_call_holds" where "queue_call_holds"."queue_entry_id" = "queue_entries"."id" and "queue_call_holds"."closed_at" is null) order by CASE WHEN (CASE (SELECT t.chosen_zone FROM visit_triage_assessments t WHERE t.visit_id = visits.id AND t.organisation_id = visits.organisation_id ORDER BY t.sequence DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN 'red' THEN 0 WHEN 'yellow' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN (CASE (SELECT t.chosen_zone FROM visit_triage_assessments t WHERE t.visit_id = visits.id AND t.organisation_id = visits.organisation_id ORDER BY t.sequence DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN 'red' THEN 0 WHEN 'yellow' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) = 0 THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM queue_emergency_alerts a WHERE a.queue_entry_id=queue_entries.id AND a.closed_at IS NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 2 END, CASE WHEN (CASE (SELECT t.chosen_zone FROM visit_triage_assessments t WHERE t.visit_id = visits.id AND t.organisation_id = visits.organisation_id ORDER BY t.sequence DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN 'red' THEN 0 WHEN 'yellow' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END) = 0 THEN COALESCE((SELECT a.raised_at FROM queue_emergency_alerts a WHERE a.queue_entry_id=queue_entries.id AND a.closed_at IS NULL), queue_entries.queued_at) END, CASE WHEN queue_entries.operational_date = ? THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE (SELECT t.chosen_zone FROM visit_triage_assessments t WHERE t.visit_id = visits.id AND t.organisation_id = visits.organisation_id ORDER BY t.sequence DESC LIMIT 1) WHEN 'red' THEN 0 WHEN 'yellow' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, CASE visits.priority WHEN 'urgent' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, "queue_entries"."operational_date" asc, "queue_entries"."queued_at" asc, "queue_entries"."id" asc limit 1
